description: End-to-end management of partner-initiated device swap requests for TAAS Camara, including eligibility checks, offer generation, approvals, provisioning, shipping, activation, and failure recovery.

partner_id.description: Identifier of the partner (e.g., MVNO, reseller) initiating or managing device swaps.

customer_id.description: Identifier of the end-customer whose device is being swapped.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of the customer's subscription within the partner or TAAS platform.

swap_request_id.description: Unique identifier for a device swap request.

order_id.description: Unique identifier for a logistics or fulfillment order associated with a device swap.

device_id.description: Identifier of a physical device (IMEI/serial or internal inventory ID).

inventory_pool_id.description: Identifier for an inventory pool or warehouse used for device allocation.

offer_id.description: Identifier for a generated swap offer configuration.

workflow_correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier used to track the full lifecycle of a device swap workflow across systems.

functions.name: register_partner_profile
functions.description: Create or update a partner profile and device swap configuration for a TAAS Camara integration.

partner_id.description: Partner identifier; if omitted, a new partner profile is created.

swap_policies.description: Rules governing when and how the partner may trigger device swaps.

swap_status_webhook.description: URL to be called when swap status changes.

inventory_alert_webhook.description: URL to be called when inventory thresholds are reached.

functions.returns: Partner profile details including partner_id and applied swap_policies.

functions.name: check_swap_eligibility
functions.description: Check whether a customer subscription is eligible for a device swap and enumerate allowed swap options.

purchase_date.description: ISO 8601 date of original device purchase.

diagnostics.description: Results from partner-side device diagnostics, if available.

raw_report_url.description: Optional URL to a full diagnostics report.

workflow_correlation_id.description: Optional correlation id supplied by partner for tracking.

functions.returns: Eligibility decision with reasons, allowed swap tiers, and recommended next actions.

functions.name: list_available_swap_devices
functions.description: List candidate replacement devices from configured inventory pools for a swap scenario.

preferred_inventory_pools.description: Preferred inventory pools (e.g., regional warehouses). If omitted, all eligible pools are considered.

max_monthly_fee_delta.description: Maximum allowed monthly subscription increase for an upgrade swap.

paging.description: Paging configuration for large result sets.

include.description: Related information to include with each device.

functions.returns: Paginated list of candidate replacement devices with pricing, availability, and pool information.

functions.name: create_swap_offer
functions.description: Create a swap offer that binds a candidate replacement device, pricing, and conditions for customer approval.

swap_request_context.description: Context from the eligibility check or partner system.

source_swap_request_id.description: If the partner already created a swap_request_id on their side.

proposed_device.description: The device and inventory pool being proposed.

commit_mode.description: Whether stock is reserved at offer creation.

monthly_fee_delta.description: Increase or decrease in monthly subscription fee.

return_requirements.description: Conditions under which the old device must be returned.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 datetime from which the offer is valid.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 datetime until which the offer is valid.

functions.returns: Swap offer details including offer_id, pricing breakdown, and reservation state.

functions.name: approve_or_reject_swap_offer
functions.description: Approve or reject a previously created swap offer and initiate formal swap request when approved.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when decision was captured.

rejection_reason.description: If rejected, explanation from customer or partner.

functions.returns: Result of approval action; when approved, a new swap_request_id and initial status are returned.

functions.name: create_swap_request
functions.description: Create a new device swap request directly (without prior offer) or based on an existing approved offer.

offer_id.description: Optional ID of a previously approved offer; when provided, device and financials will default from the offer.

swap_details.description: Explicit swap details (used when no offer_id is provided or to override offer defaults).

addresses.description: Address details for shipping or pickup.

pickup_location_id.description: If store_pickup or locker_pickup is chosen.

return_logistics.description: Return logistics for the old device, if required.

functions.returns: Newly created swap request with swap_request_id, initial status, and linked offer or override details.

functions.name: get_swap_request_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status, timeline, and related artifacts for a swap request.
functions.returns: Swap request status, key milestones, and any requested related objects.

functions.name: update_swap_request
functions.description: Modify mutable fields of an existing swap request before fulfillment is locked in.

update_mask.description: List of top-level fields that are being updated (e.g., 'addresses.shipping_address', 'swap_details.shipping_preference').

swap_details.description: New values for swap_details (if being updated).

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying this update.

functions.returns: Updated swap request representation including new status if changes affect fulfillment.

functions.name: initiate_fulfillment_for_swap
functions.description: Trigger device provisioning and logistics for an approved swap request.

provisioning.description: Configuration for network or platform provisioning of the replacement device.

esim_profile.description: ESIM profile information if esim_activation is chosen.

pre_activation_tests.description: Tests to run before handing device over to customer.

shipping.description: Shipping instructions for the new device.

functions.returns: Fulfillment initiation result including one or more order_id values, initial shipment tracking info, and provisioning tasks.

functions.name: cancel_or_rollback_swap_request
functions.description: Cancel a pending or in-progress swap request and optionally roll back any provisioning or inventory reservations.

rollback_strategy.description: Determines how far the platform attempts to roll back effects of the swap.

force.description: If true, attempt cancellation even if swap is near completion, possibly requiring manual follow-up.

functions.returns: Cancellation outcome, any completed rollback actions, and residual tasks that may require manual processing.

functions.name: retry_swap_step
functions.description: Retry a failed or stuck step in the swap workflow, such as provisioning, shipping label creation, or activation.

step_type.description: The type of step to retry.

last_failed_attempt_id.description: An identifier for the previous failed attempt, if available.

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides to adjust behavior on retry.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key for the retry operation.

functions.returns: Retry execution result including new attempt id, updated step status, and any remaining errors.

functions.name: list_swap_requests
functions.description: List swap requests for a partner with filtering and pagination for operational monitoring.
functions.returns: Paginated list of swap_request entries with key fields for dashboard or back-office use.

functions.name: confirm_device_activation
functions.description: Confirm that the replacement device has been successfully activated and optionally close the swap workflow.

errors.description: If failed or partial_success, list of encountered errors.

close_workflow_when_successful.description: If true and activation is successful, the swap workflow is transitioned to a final 'activated' state.

functions.returns: Updated swap request with final or intermediate activation state and any post-activation actions required.

functions.name: bulk_import_swap_requests
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple swap_requests from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined swap_requests, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_swap_requests
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of swap_requests matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped swap_requests with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_swap_requests
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of swap_requests with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_swap_requests
functions.description: Export a filtered set of swap_requests to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_swap_requests_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across swap_requests with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with swap_requests hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_swap_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on swap lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_swap_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing swap subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_swap_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a swap subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_swap_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single swap with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across swap_requests for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_swap_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of swap_requests.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_swap_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to swap_requests with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of swap jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_swap_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight swap job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_swap_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a swap (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_swap_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive swap change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_swap_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a swap approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_swap_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a swap, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_swap_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a swap, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_swap
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a swap for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_swap_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a swap from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_swap_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over swap_requests (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched swap_requests.

functions.name: build_swap_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over swap_requests data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_swap_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern swap behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_swap_policies
functions.description: List policies governing swap_requests with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_swap_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a swap and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
